name: search_customers
description: Search customers by name or email and return matching customer records.

name: find_customer
description: Find customer records matching a name or email address.

name: delete_customer
description: Permanently delete a customer and all of their data. Do not use for deactivation; use deactivate_customer instead.

name: get_customer_context
description: Return one customer's profile, last 20 transactions, and open support notes in a single call. Use when you already have a customer_id; not for searching by name.
